ashley_ops: pinging @lily_fwd — manifest vs tracking mismatch. Our intake shows 12 units, carrier tracking shows 10. AWB on PO# 4521 is 1Z999AA10123456784. Can you confirm shipped split and ETA for the missing pieces? Also need clarity on insurance/duties.

lily_fwd: hey Ashley — carrier split the shipment into two AWBs earlier today, sorry for the confusion. We shipped 8 on AWB A and 4 on AWB B. The scanning hub delayed two scans which is why your tracker shows 10. ETA for AWB B is ~48h. Insurance declared value per unit is $18,000; vendor retains responsibility for duties per PO. Will post serials + CSV by EOD.

juan_ops: we need the serial list ASAP so staging can reserve racks & start prechecks. If DOA rate >1% we’ll likely trigger loaner flow. Any expected DOA rate from this vendor batch?

lily_fwd: no abnormal DOA historically on this lot — vendor QC passed. I'll attach the serial CSV in the intake ticket and flag any units that had factory rework. Insurance docs + broker invoice will go into the same ticket.

sophie_sre: FYI if eu-west sees >2 DOA we trigger emergency loaner policy (see runbook). Tagging @maria_sales for customer notifications if dedicated pools affected. :thinking:

ashley_ops: can you paste the 2 AWB numbers and which serials are on each? procurement sheet needs exact mapping to reconcile costs and insurance exposure.

lily_fwd: AWB A: 1Z999AA10123456784A (8 units) -> serials S1001,S1002,S1003,S1004,S1005,S1006,S1007,S1008
AWB B: 1Z999AA10123456784B (4 units) -> serials S1009,S1010,S1011,S1012
Carrier confirmed the two missing scans are inbound to the hub; no DOA reported at pickup. CSV attached to ticket IN-4521 (will paste snippet below).

lily_fwd: ```serial,awb
S1001,1Z999AA10123456784A

S1012,1Z999AA10123456784B
```

warehouse-bot: Received manifest correction from vendor. Auto-created intake ticket IN-4521. Link: https://ops.internal/ticket/IN-4521

juan_ops: good — next Qs: RMA flow if any DOA on arrival? vendor to open RMA or do we open? pre-paid label? replacement lead time? Also need to know if vendor provides firmware wipe or whether depot handles secure erase.

lily_fwd: vendor policy: they initiate RMA within 48h after receipt confirmation. They provide pre-paid return labels and will ship exchanges within 7 business days (subject to depot availability). Depot to perform secure erase — vendor does not include wipe step by default. If you need vendor-handled erase, add to PO SOW and expect +3 business days.

maria_sales: noted — I'll prep customer comms for any onboarding slippage (48–72h). For customers with Dedicated pools we may offer temporary capacity credits if onboarding is delayed >72h.

ashley_ops: thanks. Can you confirm who covers customs duties for the split AWB? We had some disputes last quarter.

lily_fwd: duties per PO terms: vendor covers. We'll upload broker invoice and proof of payment into IN-4521 within 1h.

sophie_sre: action item added to runbook: create loaner request template when vendor batch arrives. If DOA >2 in eu-west, ops-oncall to request 10 loaners from vendor to cover next-48h.

ops-oncall: acknowledged — prepping template. If we need to spin loaners, I'll open expedited procurement and cc @maria_sales.

ashley_ops: appreciate it. Leaving this open until ticket IN-4521 has CSV + broker invoice. Will close when we reconcile procurement sheet and upload receipts.
